newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodian police release Australian businessman.
newsitem.headline: Cambodian police release Australian businessman.

text.p: Cambodian police on Friday released the president of the Australian Business Association of Cambodia after one week's detention on suspicion of theft from a creditor, a partner said on Saturday.
"He's been released," said Simon Parr, a partner of John Harper in the food import and distribution company, United Distributors Cambodia.
It was not clear if Harper, who also runs a popular restaurant in Phnom Penh and helped revive Cambodia's beer brewing industry, faced any legal action.
Harper was taken into custody on January 24 after allegedly breaking into a house of a European creditor and taking away goods as security for a debt.
Police could not immediately be contacted for comment.
